sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
🖤 Deep black stones in a sleek, continuous tennis row

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 ✨ Rich 24K gold-tone finish for a premium look

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 📏 Slim 4mm width that layers or wears solo with ease

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 🔒 19cm length with a secure, comfortable clasp

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
1. Slip the bracelet over your wrist and fasten the clasp securely.

2. Wear it solo for a refined statement or stack it with other bracelets for a layered look.

3. After wear, wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and store in a dry pouch to keep the shine.

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Meet the Black Tennis Bracelet – 24K Gold Tone, a sleek and elegant piece designed around a striking contrast of deep black stones and a rich gold-toned finish. The result is a look that feels both modern and timeless on the wrist.
Crafted in a refined 4mm tennis-style design, the bracelet features a clean, continuous row of black stones that add depth, shine and a bold edge. The 24K gold tone setting lifts the whole piece, making it just as suited to everyday wear as it is to special occasions.
The 19cm length sits gracefully for a comfortable, secure fit, adding a subtle statement without ever feeling heavy. Minimal yet eye-catching, it is easy to wear on its own or layer with other bracelets for a more elevated, stacked look.

• 
Black tennis design – sleek contrast with a modern edge.

• 
24K gold tone – rich shine with a premium finish.

• 
4mm width – slim, elegant and easy to style.

• 
19cm length – designed for a secure, comfortable fit.

Whether worn alone for a refined statement or stacked for a layered style, the Black Tennis Bracelet adds a touch of elegance, confidence and contemporary luxury to your everyday look.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. What is the length of this bracelet?

The bracelet is 19cm long, designed to sit securely and comfortably on most wrists.

2. Is the black colour of the stones permanent?

Yes. The deep black stones hold their colour and shine with normal wear and basic care.

3. Will the gold tone fade?

With everyday care — keeping it away from water, perfume and sweat and wiping it dry after wear — the 24K gold-tone finish keeps its rich shine for a long time.

4. Can I stack it with other bracelets?

Absolutely. The slim 4mm design layers beautifully with other bracelets or wears well on its own.

5. Is it suitable for daily wear?

Yes. The minimal design and secure clasp make it comfortable enough for everyday wear as well as special occasions.
